# Lee Lin

> Lee Lin (Chinese: 林感) is a solo AI builder shipping consumer products from Boston. Babson College Class of 2027. Currently building Resume2Web and Semori.

## About Lee Lin

Lee Lin (Chinese name: 林感) is a business student at Babson College, Class of 2027, based in Boston, Massachusetts. He builds consumer AI products solo and is active across the US and China — primarily Boston, San Francisco, and Beijing. He writes about AI, startups, and frontier tech, and ships products in public.

## Pages

- [Home](https://leelin.vercel.app/): Single-page portfolio. Sections: About, Projects, Experiences, Off-screen, Contact.

## Projects

- [Resume2Web](https://r2w.online): AI tool that turns a resume PDF into a personalized portfolio website in about 30 seconds. Solo-built; over 100 users acquired through self-led GTM.
- [Semori](https://semori.online): AI personal knowledge base. Ingests bookmarks from Twitter, YouTube, Xiaohongshu, and RSS into a searchable semantic library with a weekly digest.
